subject.title: feat(ui): approval UX overhaul — inline cards, fair queue, shortcuts, badges

question: After the concrete correctness and proof blockers are resolved, should OpenClaw adopt this large Control UI approval-workflow redesign as the supported approval interaction model?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes the prominent user-facing approval workflow across modal, chat, sidebar, and keyboard interactions; accepting that product scope is a maintainer decision separate from fixing the identified regressions.

options.title: Sponsor the redesign after fixes
options.body: Accept the inline, queue, shortcut, and badge direction once alias handling, short-pane access, and live behavior proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Keep only a smaller approval usability improvement and defer the broader inline/sidebar/shortcut model to a separately sponsored design.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the redesign after fixes
recommendation.body: Accept the inline, queue, shortcut, and badge direction once alias handling, short-pane access, and live behavior proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history shows sustained ownership of the proposed approval UX direction, though current-main ownership evidence was unavailable.
